# easydns_zone (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about an existing DNS zone in EasyDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "easydns_zone" "main" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "zone_service" {
  value = data.easydns_zone.main.service
}

output "zone_exists" {
  value = data.easydns_zone.main.exists
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name of the zone.

### Read-Only

- `exists` (Boolean) Whether the zone exists.
- `expiry` (String) The expiry date of the domain registration, if applicable.
- `id` (String) The zone identifier.
- `next_due` (String) The next billing due date.
- `on_system` (Boolean) Whether the zone is active on the EasyDNS system.
- `service` (String) The service ID associated with the zone.
